app.title: Lights Out Solver
instructions.goal.description:
"Lights Out Puzzle" is a classic puzzle game where the goal is to activate all the cells on a board.

Toggling the state of one light affects its neighbors.
instructions.states.mixed.name: Marked & Active
instructions.states.mixed.tooltip: This tiles are marked and active at the same time
instructions.states.marked.name: Marked
instructions.states.marked.tooltip: Click all this tiles to solve the board
instructions.states.active.name: Active
instructions.states.active.tooltip: Activate tiles by directly clicking or by nearby cells
instructions.states.default.name: Off
instructions.states.default.tooltip: Default state of the cells you can toggle from active to this state
